x-bump-note: 1.0.0 initial. Per-baton run-end completion receipt, written by the engine at the run's terminal commit and never hand-authored. DR-097 push-side duty: ATTACHES (the engine repo vendors this schema and emits the matching CompletionReceipt cockpit entity); the hold is HOLDING until the engine repo vendors it, tracked by the memo thread 2026-10-01-coordinator-content-repo-em-completion-receipts. Spec backlink: pln-run-end-completion-receipts-69aeb1 § C0.
description: What one execute-plan or mise-en-place run concluded for one baton, and who vouched for it. Stored as state/completion-receipts/<YYYY-MM>/<receipt_id>.md: this frontmatter, then a prose body (what concluded, what was observed, what remains). Append-only: a receipt is never edited after its commit; human approval is a new human-approved receipt whose supersedes names the agent-delivered one. `superseded` is never written into a file; a reader derives it from a later receipt's supersedes. The verdict lives here and never on the baton (DR-176). Spec backlink: pln-run-end-completion-receipts-69aeb1 § Pinned interfaces.

baton_id.description: Id of the baton the run claimed. At least one of baton_id and deliverable_id is non-null.

deliverable_id.description: Deliverable spine id of the work the run concluded. At least one of baton_id and deliverable_id is non-null.

workstream_id.description: Workstream slug grouping this receipt with its siblings; null when unknown.

repo.description: Repo key the run ran in.

plan_path.description: Repo-relative plan path; null for a mise item with no plan.

branch.description: Branch the run committed on; null when unknown.

kind.description: Which run produced the receipt. A new run kind is an additive enum widen, a MINOR rung here and on the cockpit entity.

verdict.description: agent-delivered = terminal judge met; human-approved / rejected = an appended human act (supersedes and approved_by non-null); null = the run concluded without a met judge (not_met, indeterminate, delivery not PASS, a CONTINUANCE item, or no plan to judge). `superseded` is derived by readers, never written.

observation_summary.description: What the judge observed that earned the verdict.

judged_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC time of the judgment.

judge.description: The terminal judge's record. Non-null whenever verdict is agent-delivered.

commit_range.description: Commits the run landed, base exclusive to head inclusive; null when the run committed nothing.

started_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC run start; null when unknown.

actual.description: Measured t-shirt for the run; null when not captured.

prose_ref.description: Repo-relative path of this receipt file.

supersedes.description: receipt_id of the receipt this one supersedes; null for a first receipt.

approved_by.description: Human who approved or rejected; null for an agent-written receipt.

provenance.description: Shaped after the cockpit ProvenanceEnvelope (cockpit-contract README § Entities, DECISIONS D5); not imported from it.

derivation.description: How the receipt's facts were derived.
